args.prompt: A sprite kit for a cute 2D pixel art game background: exactly 8 separate objects arranged in a clean grid of 4 columns by 2 rows, each object fully visible, well separated with plenty of empty space around it, none touching or overlapping. Soft pastel 16-bit pixel art with hard square chunky pixels, simple flat shading with one highlight tone and one shadow tone, light from the top left, NO dark outlines (soft background art), no anti-aliasing, no text, no labels. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else. Same warm pastel palette family as the reference drawing (lavender, pink and yellow). Theme: STARRY NIGHT SKY. The 8 objects are: (1) a big crescent moon with a sleepy smiling face, (2) a big dark-lavender cloud with a softly lit pale edge, (3) a medium dark-lavender cloud with a lit edge, (4) a small dark cloud, (5) a constellation of five stars connected by thin lines in the shape of a candy, (6) a shooting star with a short trail, (7) a big five-pointed yellow glowing star, (8) a cluster of three small twinkling stars. Night palette: deep indigo, violet, pale yellow.
